name: shiplogue
description: Drafts your daily stand-up from the work you already did. Local-first for VS Code, Cursor and Antigravity: git, IDE activity and GitHub become a Done / Next / Blockers update, written by a local model or your own API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenAI-compatible), then copied or posted to Discord/Slack.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Shiplogue reads real repository history and local editor activity, which virtual workspaces do not provide.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Shiplogue runs git commands in the workspace and records local activity, so it requires a trusted workspace.

commands.title: Shiplogue: Set API Key (Bring Your Own)

shiplogue.lookbackHours.description: How many hours back to gather activity when generating a stand-up.

shiplogue.ollama.url.description: Base URL of your local Ollama server.

shiplogue.ollama.model.description: Ollama model to use for summarizing your activity.

shiplogue.ollama.numPredict.markdownDescription: Maximum tokens the model may generate. `0` (default) uses the per-detail budget (400/900/1600). Raise this if a reasoning model returns nothing.

shiplogue.ollama.numCtx.description: Context window size (tokens) passed to Ollama. Raise it on busy days if your activity is being cut off.

enumDescriptions: Let the model decide; if it returns nothing, Shiplogue retries once with thinking disabled and a larger budget
Always enable reasoning (think: true)
Always disable reasoning (think: false)
shiplogue.ollama.think.markdownDescription: Control reasoning ('thinking') models such as gpt-oss or deepseek-r1.

enumDescriptions: Use a configured API provider if there is one, otherwise Ollama
Bundled local model (not included in the 0.1.x beta)
Use the configured provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or OpenAI-compatible)
Use the local Ollama server
shiplogue.model.backend.markdownDescription: Which engine writes your stand-up. `auto` never falls back silently between hosted providers; with no provider configured it uses Ollama.

enumDescriptions: No API provider configured
Anthropic (Claude)
OpenAI
Google Gemini
Any endpoint that speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions API — OpenRouter, Groq, Together, LM Studio, llama.cpp
shiplogue.provider.type.description: API provider used when shiplogue.model.backend is 'provider' or 'auto'.

shiplogue.provider.model.markdownDescription: Model id for the configured provider (for example `claude-sonnet-4-5`, `gpt-4o-mini`, `gemini-2.5-flash`). Run **Shiplogue: Set API Key** to pick from the provider's model list.

shiplogue.provider.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Endpoint base URL for `openai-compatible` providers, e.g. `http://localhost:1234/v1` or `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`. Paths should not include `/chat/completions`.

shiplogue.provider.maxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Hard cap on tokens the provider may generate. `0` uses the per-detail budget (400/900/1600); a positive value caps it with `Math.min`. If a thinking model returns no answer because it spent the budget on reasoning, Shiplogue retries once with a larger budget (at least 4096) and thinking disabled.

shiplogue.github.useBuiltInAuth.markdownDescription: Use the editor's built-in GitHub sign-in instead of a manual token. No PAT needed — run 'Shiplogue: Connect GitHub' once. Ignored if `shiplogue.github.token` is set.

shiplogue.github.token.markdownDescription: Optional GitHub personal access token. Only needed if you prefer NOT to use built-in sign-in (e.g. headless use). Leave empty to use built-in auth.

shiplogue.github.repos.markdownDescription: Repos to check, as `owner/name`. If empty, Shiplogue auto-detects from the current workspace's git `origin` remote.

enumDescriptions: Only activity from the folders open in this window (default)
Activity from all projects you worked on today, across every workspace
shiplogue.scope.description: Which activity a generated stand-up includes. 'workspace' keeps each project's stand-up clean; 'all' combines your whole day.

enumDescriptions: 3-4 short points, outcomes only
5-7 points with the key specifics (files, endpoints, issue numbers)
6-9 thorough points enumerating files, assets, fields and URLs — a full work log
shiplogue.detail.description: How detailed the generated stand-up should be. Also switchable from the stand-up panel.

enumDescriptions: Default voice — no styling added
Mentions what you learned and where you asked for help
Plain and factual, with brief reasoning
Leads with impact and decisions; terse
shiplogue.tone.description: Voice of the generated stand-up. Also switchable from the stand-up panel.

shiplogue.webhook.type.description: Where the Send button posts your stand-up.

shiplogue.webhook.url.markdownDescription: Incoming webhook URL for Discord or Slack. No bot or OAuth needed — create an incoming webhook in your channel settings.

shiplogue.track.enabled.description: Track IDE activity (which files you edit and save). Stored locally only.

shiplogue.generate.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Abort stand-up generation after this many seconds (a Cancel button is always available too). `0` disables the timeout.

shiplogue.store.retentionDays.markdownDescription: Delete locally stored activity logs older than this many days on startup. `0` keeps them forever.

shiplogue.reminder.enabled.description: Show a daily local-time notification reminding you to send your stand-up.

shiplogue.reminder.time.markdownDescription: Daily reminder time in 24h `HH:MM`, local time. Set on first run; change any time here or via 'Shiplogue: Set Reminder Time'.

shiplogue.cursor.enabled.markdownDescription: Include the AI prompts you gave Cursor's assistant today as context for the stand-up. Read locally & read-only from Cursor's chat DB; nothing is uploaded. No effect if Cursor isn't installed.
